marketing.headline: Run your pool without the spreadsheet.
marketing.subhead: Poolse organises the sites, the tanks and the staff for the people who run swimming pools — schools, municipal pools, hotels and condominiums.
marketing.comingNote: Not built yet. It is on the plan, in this order.
marketing.ctaBody: Create your organization, add your sites, bring in your staff. Under five minutes, no card needed.

facilities.title: Sites and pools
facilities.body: Several locations, each with its own tanks, lanes and volume.

people.title: Invite your staff
people.body: Invite by email; they arrive with the roles you gave them.

roles.title: Roles per person
roles.body: Owner, administrator, instructor, maintenance — several at once.

languages.title: Portuguese and English
languages.body: Each person picks their own language and theme.

classes.title: Class groups and schedules
classes.body: Recurring lessons, holidays, and the month of August.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Mark a class in under a minute.

billing.title: Fees and invoices
billing.body: Who owes what, with direct debit and MB WAY.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.body: pH, temperature, tasks and out-of-range alerts.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subhead: Three plans. The amounts are not settled yet — what they include is.
pricing.questionsBody: Not yet. The product is still being built, and announcing a price that has not been decided would be worse than leaving this blank.

partners.perSite: A partnership belongs to this site. The same school using two of the club pools is two partnerships, each with its own agreement, price and contact.
partners.none: No partnerships at this site yet.
partners.name: Name
partners.nameTaken: A partnership with that name already exists at this site.
partners.nifHint: Nine digits. Needed to invoice the organisation.
partners.colorHint: Tints this partnership cells on the lane grid. The group name is always shown as text as well.
partners.statusHint: An inactive partnership stops being offered when booking hours, but keeps all its history.
partners.inUse: This partnership still has hours booked on the grid. Remove the bookings first, or set it to inactive.
partners.contactRoleHint: What the organisation calls them. E.g. Head of Physical Education.
partners.contactReachable: A contact needs an email address or a telephone number.

partners.paymentPeriodHint: E.g. monthly, quarterly, at the end of the season.

partners.participantCountHint: Zero is a valid answer for a group that has not been sized yet.
partners.countInvalid: Enter a whole number, zero or more.

partners.ownInstructorHint: Shown on the timetable. The group does not appear in the unstaffed-class alerts.
